activities.name: Invoke
activities.whenToUse: Use to run the supplied HydrationPlan against the current Signal and ItemSignal. The helper interprets each character as a dispatch step; unknown symbols are warned and skipped. The default ^ recursively calls the same plan, so it does not establish safe fixed-point completion.

properties.whenToUse: Supply an explicit sequence of current dispatch symbols (*, @, +, -, ~, #, $) for the desired mapped slots. Omission defaults to ^, whose branch recurses with the unchanged Plan and can fail to terminate; do not assume it converges.
properties.description: Choose the hydration dispatch symbols; ^ recursively reuses the same Plan and may not terminate.

result.description: When delegates supplied hydration plan; hydration helper succeeds (Result presence conditional).
